entities.name: Query protein 577 aa
observations: 577-aa protein; estimated mass 61.9 kDa and theoretical pI 5.83.
Strong homology to E. coli pyruvate dehydrogenase [ubiquinone] P07003: 60% identity and 99.5% query coverage; likely TPP-dependent pyruvate oxidoreductase.
Contains TPP_enzyme_N, TPP_enzyme_M, and TPP_enzyme_C Pfam domains; inferred cofactors include ThDP, Mg2+, and FAD based on homologs.
Exact reaction, cellular localization, and oligomeric state are not experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: E. coli P07003
observations: Reviewed Swiss-Prot homolog annotated as pyruvate dehydrogenase [ubiquinone], EC 1.2.5.1; binds FAD, Mg2+, and thiamine diphosphate; reported homotetramer and peripheral inner-membrane localization.
